'''Hagamoor City''' was a city on [[Hagamoor 3]]. In [[44 ABY]], former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] visited this city.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse" />
